scope: Proposition 3.1 (Estimates on retained data) of the manuscript “Generalized outer-electron radii of neutral Coulomb atoms” (preprints/Generalized-outer-electron-radii-of-neutral-Coulomb-atoms-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 263 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 15737301853393ce), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are deterministic integers qℓ → ∞ and jℓ < Jℓ, and events Gℓ ∈ Fjℓ with P(Gℓ) → 1, such that aℓ := rjℓ sℓ ∈ [︃ 1 2qℓ , 1 qℓ ]︃ . (3.2) Put λℓ = Zℓs3 ℓ and, on each retained datum, define Fℓ(x) = s4 ℓ Hjℓ (sℓx), σℓ(x) = s6 ℓ µjℓ (sℓx), Uℓ(x) = s4 ℓ ujℓ (sℓx), pℓ(x) = s6 ℓ pjℓ (sℓx). (3.3) These fields satisfy the exact identities σℓ ≥ 0, ∫︂ R3 σℓ dx = λℓ, Fℓ = λℓK − K ∗ σℓ, ∆Fℓ = −4πλℓδ0 + 4πσℓ, (3.4) and, simultaneously on aℓ ≤ |x| ≤ qℓ, Fℓ(x) ≤ Ccap|x|−4 , ⃓ ⃓σℓ(x) − k(Fℓ(x)+)3/2 ⃓ ⃓ ≤ q−8 ℓ |x|−6 . (3.5) The scaled subsolution obeys, in distributions on R3, ∆Uℓ ≥ −4πλℓδ0 + 4π1{|x|<aℓ}σℓ − 4πpℓ + 1{|x|≥aℓ}f(Uℓ), (3.6) with B|x|−4 (︃ 1 − aℓ 8|x| )︃ ≤ Uℓ(x) ≤ Cinv|x|−4 (|x| ≥ aℓ), (3.7) and pℓ ≥ 0, supp pℓ ⊂ {|x| ≤ aℓ}, ∫︂ R3 pℓ dx ≤ s3 ℓ . (3.8) For each finite system, σℓ is a bounded smooth density, pℓ is a bounded density, and both Fℓ − λℓK and Uℓ − λℓK extend continuously and locally Lipschitz through the origin. All these assertions hold for every datum in Gℓ, so they may be used along arbitrary selections of retained data.
